viewContainer.name: GitBoard
welcome.noRepos:
No Git repository found in the current workspace.
[Open Commit Graph](command:gitboard.open)
cfg.gitPath: Path to the git executable. Leave empty to auto-detect (built-in Git extension, then `git` on PATH).
cfg.commitPageSize: Number of commits loaded per page from `git log`.
cfg.maxAutoLoad: Stop auto-loading more commits after this many are loaded (a "Load more" button remains).
cfg.fetchOnOpen: Run `git fetch` automatically when the graph view opens.
cfg.autoFetchInterval: Background auto-fetch interval in minutes (SourceTree-style); 0 = disable. Runs only while the GitBoard panel is open: silently fetches all remotes of the current repo (honors the prune setting), no progress bar, failures only logged; badges and the graph update automatically when new commits arrive.
cfg.pullFetchSummary: Show a summary popup of incoming commits after Pull/Fetch (merges excluded, changed files listed).
cfg.dateFormat: Time column format in the commit list.
cfg.rowHeight: Row height of the commit list.
cfg.graphStyle: Graph line style: github (GitHub-style thin lines, arc turns, hollow merge dots; default), curved (short-radius corners) or angular (right-angle).
cfg.graphColumnWidth: Width of the graph column in pixels.
cfg.showRemoteChips: Show remote-branch chips on commit rows.
cfg.maxTagChips: Maximum tag chips shown on one commit row.
cfg.detailPanelPosition: Position of the commit detail panel.
cfg.showStatusBarItem: Show the current branch in the status bar.
cfg.startView: Which view to show when opening GitBoard.
cfg.ai.enabled: Enable AI-generated commit messages via GitHub Copilot (uses your VS Code Copilot sign-in; entry is hidden when unavailable).
cfg.ai.modelFamily: Preferred Copilot model family (empty = default model).
cfg.ai.language: Language of generated commit messages (auto = follow recent commits).
cfg.ai.learnFromHistory: Learn style/language from the 10 most recent commits when generating.
cfg.ai.useWorkspaceInstructions: Follow workspace instruction files (.copilot/, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .github/instructions/*.instructions.md) when generating.
cfg.commit.clearMessage: Clear the commit message box after a successful commit.
cfg.commit.pushAfter: Default state of the "Push after commit" checkbox.
cfg.revealSelectStyle: "Reveal in file manager" argument style for explorer.exe (its /select parsing varies across Windows builds). classic = single raw argument (works on all builds); separate/quoted are fallbacks for exotic environments.
cfg.logOrder: Commit ordering for git log. topo keeps graph lines tidy (default); date is faster on very large repos.
